thread:
maria_pmad: Quick thread to prioritize console observability work for the next two sprints. Need to decide scope tradeoffs between dashboards, trace hooks (full span stitching), cost breakdowns, and error analytics.

nik_dev: tl;dr: we can do a lightweight dashboard now (estimates from sampled signals) and defer full-span stitching to phase 2.

rachel_prod: Customers pushing for two things specifically: 1) per-route cost cards in the Console, 2) actionable traces that show model call boundaries when errors occur. They want to be able to tie a spike to a specific model version.

olivia_csm: From the pilot cohort: Per-route cost + top-N error traces = highest ROI. Exports & 30d raw trace retention are desirable but not mandatory for pilot.

lee_sre: Reliability constraints: any dashboard query must complete within 1.5s at 75th percentile. Trace ingestion needs a backpressure path if storage queue grows > threshold.
jordan_infra: Two engineering risks: tagging spans at the edge (to know the model/variant) and sampling load. We should do front-door tags with minimal payload and then enrich server-side for displayed traces.

maria_pmad: Proposed product split:
- MVP (sprint 1): dashboard cards (per-route cost estimate, calls/day, cost/call), confidence band shown; basic sampled traces with model-span marker (no raw export).
- Phase 2 (sprint 2-3): full-span stitching for downstream calls, per-model-version cost attribution, export to S3/BQ behind feature flag.
- Phase 3: retention export + enterprise controls (per-customer sampling overrides, quotas).

nik_dev: Implementation note: for MVP we'll compute cost as token-cost * sampled_weight and display a 90% CI. That keeps compute low and avoids full ingress.

```yaml
sampling_policy:
  baseline: 0.0005  # 0.05%
  error_capture: 1.0
  latency_capture: 0.05
  route_overrides: {}
```

nik_dev: We'll also emit a sample_confidence field on dashboard metrics.

rachel_prod: For prioritization: if we can commit to per-route cost + sample_confidence in sprint 1, sales can schedule two pilot onboardings. Otherwise push to next quarter.

maria_pmad: Acceptance checklist for MVP (product sign-off):
- cost card: per-route cost estimate + 90% confidence band, windows 1h/24h/30d (UI controls).
- error traces: trace list surface shows model-span and error tag, link to raw trace JSON modal.
- perf: dashboard queries <1.5s p75.
- controls: Console toggle for "Enable high-fidelity traces" at org level.

lee_sre: Add monitoring SLOs: trace-ingest-queue-length, dashboard-query-latency, cost-estimation-delta (compare sampled vs ground truth in a test harness).
jordan_infra: Will need an edge tag: model_name, model_version, quant_profile, route_id. Minimize size: use short keys.

olivia_csm: Customer-facing language for pilot email (short):
"We're rolling out per-route cost visibility and error traces that show model boundaries. Pilot customers will get a dashboard + opt-in high-fidelity traces feature. Export to your storage is planned for later"

maria_pmad: Rollout plan:
- internal alpha (team-only) 3 days after RFC merge
- pilot to 4 customers for 6 weeks (monitoring gates)
- GA if gates pass

nik_dev: Rollout gates (engineering):
1) dashboard query p75 <1.5s
2) sample ingestion rate within quota (configurable)
3) cost-estimation error <= 20% on 95th traffic slice in sim harness
4) no data-loss incidents in pilot window

lee_sre: Add automatic fallback: if ingest rate > X or queue length > Y, flip org to low-sample mode and notify admins.

jordan_infra: For the sim harness, we'll run a skewed workload: 70% traffic to single route, 30% to many. Validate per-route math. I'll own the harness.

maria_pmad: Owners & action items
- @nik_dev: RFC + implementation PR for sampling and dashboard aggregation, due Tue EOD.
- @jordan_infra: edge tagging spec + sim harness, due Wed.
- @olivia_csm: pilot comms + customer list, due Thu.
- @rachel_prod: coordinate sales pilot scheduling.
- @lee_sre: define monitoring alerts and rollback automation.

deploy-bot: Heads-up: scheduled deploy window Fri 02:00 UTC. Avoid canary then.

rachel_prod: One more ask from Acme: a toggle to exclude certain routes from cost calc (internal-only routes). Need this in UI by pilot.

nik_dev: OK we can add a per-route exclude flag in the Console settings panel. Will include in RFC.

maria_pmad: Good. Let's keep this tight. If no objections, we'll treat this as the agreed plan and move to RFCs. Thanks all :rocket:
